meta.parties: Thidoris Perera Et Al. v. Eliza Nona

rules.statement: An existing contract for the purpose of section 93 of the Trusts Ordinance is a contract that remains in being and not at an end, even after a breach.
rules.supporting_quote: "A thing is said to exist when it is alive and not dead. The word 'exist' means 'to be, to have actual being, to live, to continue to be'. An existing contract is therefore a contract that is in being, alive, and not at an end."
